Markets.title: Gold could top Goldman’s $4,900 forecast as options demand fuels rally
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs reports that gold could surpass its $4,900 year-end forecast due to heavy options demand, Western investing, and central bank purchases. While rising call-option activity may accelerate price gains, shifts in Federal Reserve expectations could also trigger sharper corrections.

Markets.title: Symbiotec Pharmalab gets Rs 526 crore anchor backing ahead of IPO; Citi Group, Singularity among investors
Markets.summary: Symbiotec Pharmalab raised Rs 526 crore from anchor investors like Citi Group and Singularity ahead of its Rs 1,757 crore IPO opening on August 24. The pharmaceutical company priced its shares between Rs 938 and Rs 988, with plans to use the fresh issue proceeds to repay debt.

Markets.title: India bond yields hit two-month high as rate hike fears intensify
Markets.summary: India's 10-year benchmark bond yield climbed to a two-month high of 6.88% before closing at 6.85%. This increase was driven by hawkish monetary policy minutes, potential rate hikes, and escalating tensions in West Asia.

Markets.title: FIIs near historical lows: Jio BlackRock flags potential contrarian setup for Indian equities
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investor positioning in Indian equities is near historical lows following sustained outflows. Jio BlackRock states that resilient domestic buying, reduced foreign selling, and reasonable valuations could signal a sentiment turnaround.

Markets.title: Gold rallies to 3-month high on weaker dollar, bullish technicals
Markets.summary: Gold prices reached a three-month high on Friday, marking a third consecutive weekly increase. The rally was driven by a weaker U.S. dollar and bullish technical signals.

Markets.title: Accel, 2 others sell nearly 5% stake in Amagi Media Labs for Rs 587 crore
Markets.summary: Accel and two other parties sold nearly a five percent stake in Amagi Media Labs for Rs 587 crore through open market transactions involving over one crore equity shares. The buyers included domestic mutual funds, an insurance company, and foreign investors, which led to a surge in Amagi Media Labs shares.

Geo-Political.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
Geo-Political.summary: Thirty pioneer families have moved into a closed West Bank settlement in defiance of international protests and with the backing of the Israeli government. This rapid development has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful for their safety and future.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Shortage of petrol but not patriotism as Russians feel growing impact of war
Geo-Political.summary: Russian drivers are experiencing long waiting times in fuel queues due to a domestic petrol shortage. This resource scarcity is intensifying the domestic impact of the war as the country prepares to celebrate Russian Flag Day.

Geo-Political.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
Geo-Political.summary: Three prominent Hong Kong activists were found guilty of inciting subversion under a national security law imposed by China. The charges stemmed from their efforts to organize annual vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown.

Geo-Political.title: Two teenagers seriously injured after sword attack at Swedish school
Geo-Political.summary: Two teenagers suffered serious injuries in a sword attack at a school in Sweden. Police arrested one man in connection with the incident and locked down several nearby schools.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
Geo-Political.summary: A new Ebola vaccine trial will begin in the Democratic Republic of Congo as the World Health Organization warns that the speed of infections is accelerating. About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from the virus occurred within the last 20 days.

Geo-Political.title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: The UK, Canada, and Australia condemned Israel for refusing a criminal investigation into the 2024 airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza. The strike hit the aid workers' convoy, prompting international criticism.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for ads. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic acquisition from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay ahead in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers common questions about the platform.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments across various high-tech and manufacturing sectors under eased rules for land-border nations. However, it remains unclear whether the origin of these investments is from China.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could reach nearly 7%, exceeding the central bank's previous 6.7% forecast. This optimistic outlook is driven by stronger-than-expected economic indicators, leading markets to anticipate a potential rate hike later this year.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: According to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey, India’s private sector growth likely accelerated in August. This advance estimate provides an early signal of positive changes in the country's economic sentiment and output.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Consumer fears that E20 ethanol-blended petrol reduces vehicle mileage and engine life have caused a surge in demand for premium, high-octane fuel. Consequently, high-octane petrol sales jumped from about 4% in March to 12-15% of total sales.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has reduced its sugar import duty to zero to help cool down record-high local prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sectors grew by 5.4% in July, slowing down from a revised 6% growth rate in June. This expansion was primarily driven by the iron ore, cement, and electricity sectors.

India.title: "Live For Your Mother": Sarpanch's Plea To Teen On Maharashtra Hilltop
India.summary: A village sarpanch and local residents spent three hours trying to convince a teenager to come down from a Maharashtra hilltop. Despite offering comfort and promises, their initial attempts to talk him down failed.

India.title: iPhone EMI Behind Teen, Parents' Deaths In Maharashtra Hill Horror
India.summary: A teenager in Maharashtra killed his parents following a heated argument over money to pay his iPhone EMIs. Police officials stated that the dispute arose when the teen repeatedly asked his family for funds to cover the latest installment.

India.title: "Pakistan's Frustration": India On Reaction To Sergio Gor's J&K Comment
India.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated during a press briefing that Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh are integral and indivisible parts of India. This remark was made in response to Pakistan's reaction to comments regarding the region made by Sergio Gor.

India.title: 'Should Be Common Man's Goal': Centre's 23-Point 'Viksit Bharat' Action Plan
India.summary: The Indian government has released a 23-point action plan aimed at achieving a developed nation. The guidelines were developed following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's July meeting with Union secretaries and detailed in a note by Cabinet Secretary TV Somanathan.

India.title: Inspired By Border When He Was 9, Bihar Man Realises Army Dream After 14 Attempts
India.summary: Inspired by the film 'Border' at age nine, Bihar native Kishu Singh achieved his dream of joining the Indian Army. He successfully commissioned as a Lieutenant after failing his initial 13 attempts.

India.title: Live Updates: Rahul Gandhi Ends Sit-In With Pellet Gun Victim After Cops File FIR
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi ended his sit-in protest in Delhi after police filed an FIR regarding a pellet gun firing incident. He had staged the demonstration alongside a victim of the police shooting to demand legal action.

General.title: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
General.summary: Prince Harry, Sir Elton John, and five other claimants lost a privacy lawsuit against the publisher of the Daily Mail. They must pay an initial legal bill of £9.54m within seven days, with total costs potentially reaching £34.5m.

General.title: Watch: How 'strongest' El Niño could affect weather around the world
General.summary: The Met Office warns that a powerful El Niño developing over the Pacific Ocean is likely to be the strongest in living memory. This natural climate phenomenon will affect weather patterns around the world.

General.title: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk
General.summary: The advice also applies to the over-65s and others with underlying medical conditions amid salmonella outbreak.

General.title: Steve Rosenberg: Shortage of petrol but not patriotism as Russians feel growing impact of war
General.summary: Russian drivers are experiencing long waiting times in fuel queues due to a petrol shortage. The shortage highlights the growing domestic impact of the war as Moscow prepares to celebrate Russian Flag Day.

General.title: Argentina's Paredes banned for 10 games after World Cup final clashes
General.summary: FIFA has suspended Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes for 10 matches. The ban stems from his involvement in clashes with Spanish players following the World Cup final.

General.title: Watch: UK marks first national day for victims and survivors of terrorism
General.summary: Survivors of terror attacks gathered today at the first annual National day for Victims and Survivors of terrorism.
